Ava (Mktg): Need a tight benchmark snapshot for next week's push — hero chart + 2 micro-vignettes (SMB interactive flow, enterprise batch). Idea: show latency vs $/1k tokens and call out conversion impact. Quick takes?

Marco (Data): I can produce the slices. Proposed hero CSV: latency_ms,cost_per_1k,relative_conversion. small sample: 60,1.20,1.00; 150,0.95,0.97; 300,0.65,0.90; 600,0.40,0.76.

Sam (Content): For messaging: short social hook + email subject + webinar hook. Draft social: "Latency is an ROI lever: speed drives conversions." Email subject options incoming.

Jia (Design): Hero idea: two-line chart (cost and conversion) on shared x-axis latency. Annotate common infra buckets: hosted / dedicated / private. Supporting slide A: cost breakdown by caching/batching. B: conversion waterfall for tail spikes. I can mock in Figma by tomorrow morning.

Riley (PM): Add a 1-line product callout: "Smart routing + KV caching reduce tail spikes; graceful fallback keeps UX intact." That links to our differentiation.

Ava (Mktg): Love it. Marco, can you also run sim: for 10k demo sessions/day, 1.2k tokens/session, what is expected revenue delta per 1% conversion drop? We want a concrete dollar figure to put beside the chart.

Marco (Data): On it. Rough calc: at $1200 LTV per signup and 1% baseline conversion, 1% absolute drop across 10k sessions = 100 fewer signups -> $120k LTV delta. I'll produce a table with scenarios.

Sam (Content): I'll craft three short copy variants: 1) "Faster responses, smarter economics." 2) "Latency cuts conversions — here's how to stop losing customers." 3) "Speed + smart serving = better unit economics."

Jia (Design): Colors: green = low-latency path, amber = optimized batching, red = fallback. Small timeline to show median vs 95p.

DeployBot: deploy:bench-data/2026-03-21.csv uploaded by Marco (Data) — checksum OK.

Ava (Mktg): Next steps: Marco deliver CSV + scenario table by EOD. Jia deliver 3 slide variants by 10am. Sam deliver social + 2 email subjects + 30s webinar script. Riley polish the product blurb. Reconvene tomorrow 10:30 to review.

All: :thumbsup:
